title: Good Manners, Big Heart!

intro.title: Last Time...
intro.sub:
Helper Kimi earned six stars! ⭐
Today at the park, Kimi meets someone new... and learns about magic words.

scenes.title: A New Friend!
scenes.caption:
A boy on the slide waves at Kimi.
Time to be brave and say hello!

lines.speaker: friend
lines.text: Hi! Glad to meet you. My name is Minsu.

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: Nice to meet you. I'm Kimi. I'm in first grade.

lines.speaker: friend
lines.text: How old are you?

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: I'm 8 years old. I like playing the piano! 🎹

scenes.title: The Magic Words
scenes.caption:
Two little words can make hearts happy.
Can you guess them?

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: Thank you for helping me!

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: You're welcome. It was not a big deal.

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: Mom, thank you for everything. 💛

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: Aww. I'm the one who should say thanks, my treasure.

scenes.title: Slow as a Snail
scenes.caption:
Time to go home! But Kimi is moving...
very... very... slowly...

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: It's almost time. Everyone's waiting for you!

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: I'm doing it. Wait for me...

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: Gosh, you're as slow as a snail. 🐌

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: I'm almost done! Not yet!

scenes.title: Talking-Back Trouble
scenes.caption:
Uh-oh. Kimi is grumpy, and her words
are getting a little too spicy...

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: Mom, you don't understand! Why shouldn't I tell you what I want?

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: Don't talk back to Mom. That's not polite.

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: I'm not talking back! 😠

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: Do you think you should talk like that?

scenes.title: The Thinking Chair
scenes.caption:
Kimi sits in the Thinking Chair,
and thinks... and thinks...

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: Timeout! Sit in the Thinking Chair.

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: It was not my fault! ...Well... maybe a little. 😞

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: Mommy doesn't want to punish you. But you should be responsible for your actions.

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: Mom, I'm sorry.

scenes.title: Sorry Means a Hug
scenes.caption:
A real sorry is worth more
than a thousand grumpy words.

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: Look at each other in the eyes and say sorry.

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: It was a mistake. I'm really sorry. I mean it.

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: I forgive you. Let's get along. You did so well. Two thumbs up! 👍

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: How much do you love me, Mommy?

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: My love for you is as big as the universe. You are my treasure. ❤️

songs: 🔁 Replay your favorite songs from Episodes 1 & 3!

ending.title: Big Heart, Brave Sorry!
ending.sub: To be continued... Next episode: Out and About! 🛝
